svg.title: The colony’s buildings
svg.desc: Six buildings side by side, with name, cost and a note. Extractor: 15 ice, up to 4, each one more expensive. Storehouse: 20 ice and 10 N₂, near the extractor. Housing, igloos: 30 ice and 10 N₂. Barn, with an icesheep: 25 ice and 10 N₂, raises 3 icesheep. Defense center, a tower with a cannon: 30 ice and 20 N₂, up to 8. Communication center, an antenna: 40 ice and 30 N₂, requires the extractor, housing, barn and defense.
